source.author: Jessica Howard / The Cottage Mystic; About page identifies Jess and her published Art of Lithomancy
source.edition: Lithomancy, undated public author web guide; inspected2026-11-05; distinct from uninspected2022 book
source.locator: Building Your Kit, twelve item lines; Your Personal Stone, paragraphs1–2; Performing Your Reading, priority and distant-stone qualification
source.rights_note: Modern copyrighted author text and photographs; public access is not redistribution permission. Original concise factual notes/locators only; no web-page corpus, complete copied correspondence table or artwork bundled.

source_policy.set_kind: Author example general set; not universal or mandatory. Frozen profile restricts references to these twelve roles; explicit subsets are permitted by the source’s adjustable-kit guidance.
source_policy.size: 8–13 is a flexible starting suggestion; no thirteenth role inferred.
source_policy.personal: Personal stone is optional; source example uses Lodestone as self-marker. Personal anchor must be selected explicitly; choosing another present object as personal is user-attributed designation, not a changed source association.
source_policy.reader: Without personal stone, source prioritizes objects closest to the reader. Reader position must be explicitly supplied, not assumed at origin.
source_policy.nearest: Objects closest to selected anchor receive reading priority; source supplies no unique tie-break, distance cutoff, metric, zone or fixed count of winners.
source_policy.exceptions: Distant objects may still be relevant; no farthest object is automatically excluded.
source_policy.groups: Source mentions reading groups together but gives no numeric clustering algorithm or universal combined meanings.
source_policy.sea_example: Work-change sea-set differs in symbols and personal object. Its above/external, below/internal and directional associations remain documentary, not general-set rules.
source_policy.other_authors: Wimmer sixteen-role circle and Saint Germain access-gated book methods remain separate; three inventory ranks and four variations unchanged.

spatial_contract.name: integer-center-grid-v1
spatial_contract.origin: User-declared common arbitrary zero, never implicitly the reader or personal stone.
spatial_contract.scale: Same arbitrary grid unit on both axes; no physical size, radius or occult cutoff.
spatial_contract.representation: Each object is an exact center point {x,y} or unknown/null; integers only, each -1000000..1000000 inclusive.
spatial_contract.metric: Squared Euclidean distance; exact Python integers; maximum squared distance8000000000000.
spatial_contract.ties: All equal distances retained as one group, IDs sorted only for serialization, no interpretive precedence.
spatial_contract.coincidence: Equal centers are reported; physical overlap/footprints not inferred.
spatial_contract.eligibility: All present objects except selected personal-anchor instance. Reader mode includes all objects. No role inferred from mineral, text, origin or position.
spatial_contract.unknown: Missing/unknown anchor prevents ranking. Unknown eligible positions prevent a certified global nearest; known-distance groups remain explicitly partial. Uncertainty/contradictory user relations qualify priority.
spatial_contract.incomplete: coverage must explicitly be full_example (all12unique roles) or subset (1–12unique roles). No missing object generated.
spatial_contract.directions: Signs of coordinate differences provide descriptive left/right/above/below in selected frame only. No symbolic direction or arrow orientation meaning.
spatial_contract.groups: Only explicitly user-declared groups; no automatic clustering or combined fortune. Pairwise distances are descriptive geometry.
spatial_contract.seeded: Unsupported; no new RNG or simulation.

source_labels: Original concise factual summaries, not a copied source table; web guide distinct from book. Coordinates and Euclidean metric explicitly editorial.
